name: 44087 · Twinsburg, OH
findings: ZIP 44087 (Twinsburg) has 93 nonprofit organizations. 38 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 30 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44087 (Twinsburg) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 44087 (Twinsburg) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 30 organizations here; 27% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 9 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
